title: SpawnPlugin
description: SpawnPlugin is a simple plugin that lets you travel to spawn points that a Admin or Mod sets
body:
🌍 SpawnPlugin

A simple, lightweight, and powerful spawn management plugin for your Minecraft server.

SpawnPlugin lets you easily set and manage your server’s spawn point with smooth teleportation and customizable behavior. Perfect for survival, SMP, and community servers that need a reliable central hub.

✨ Features

📍 Set Spawn Point
Quickly set the server spawn location with a command. 

🚀 Teleport to Spawn
Players can instantly return to spawn anytime.

🔁 Auto Spawn on Join (optional)
Send players to spawn automatically when they join the server.

⚡ Fast & Lightweight
No unnecessary features—just clean, optimized performance.

🔒 Permission Support
Control who can set spawn and who can use teleport commands.

🔧 Easy Configuration
Simple config file to customize behavior to your liking.

📜 Commands
/setspawn – Set the server spawn location
/spawn – Teleport to the spawn point

🔐 Permissions
spawnplugin.setspawn – اجازه to set spawn
spawnplugin.spawn – اجازه to use /spawn

🧩 Compatibility
✅ Paper / Spigot (1.21+ recommended)
✅ Works with most plugins
❌ No dependencies required
💡 Why use SpawnPlugin?

If you want a no-bloat, easy-to-use spawn system that just works, this plugin is for you. It’s designed to be simple while still giving you full control over your spawn system.
